THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES separately preserves the complete MIT grant and copyright (2024-2026 znlgis) for the vendored opengis-skills instructions; the pinned upstream root LICENSE independently confirms it and neither complete fixed tree contains nearer grant files. BruTile representative frontmatter licenses the instruction MIT, while its project-license paragraph identifies the external BruTile implementation as Apache-2.0. Referenced GIS software, basemap/data assets, services, credentials and proprietary Mapbox products retain their own terms; this index does not relicense those projects under either root MIT grant.
review_scope: Repository metadata admission: README distribution, fixed representative instructions/implementation and scoped licensing. No third-party install, execution, skill-body curation or exhaustive body audit.
review_limitations: Static representative admission review only. Complete BruTile consumer, its per-skill adaptation, common adaptation, provider and adaptation-composition module were read; the remaining 43 topical consumers and 44 other per-skill adaptations were not fully reviewed. README acknowledges tolerant handling of malformed inner quotes in some other upstream frontmatter; this does not certify all 45 as portable standard YAML. No candidate installation, helper/provider execution, DSH integration, GIS command, NuGet/network tile request or model call occurred; npm published tarball and claimed runtime/version compatibility were not exercised.
